Maya (People Ops): Hey team 1 following up from the all-hands on remote/hybrid policies and travel ops. Drop any clarifying Qs here; we'll answer live through EOD. :wave:
Priya (People Ops): Quick highlights: weekly hub day remains the baseline, managers can propose 2x a week for their teams. Offsite windows will be published quarterly.
Lina (Product): For cross-team offsites, do we have a single approval path or per-team signoff?
Maya (People Ops): Per-team signoff first (manager). For cross-team >2 days, People Ops coordinates logistics; Finance reviews aggregated budget if total >$6k.
Marcus (Eng): Budget rule: is the $1,200/person cap still the guideline? Any flexibility for travel-heavy teams?
Eve (Finance): Standard guideline is $1,200/person. Teams needing higher caps should submit an exception with justification; Finance + People Ops will consider on a case-by-case basis.
Ben (Infrastructure): If an engineer needs to access partner premises while traveling, what's the clearance process?
Priya (People Ops): Good callout. Check eng-security channel checklist and submit the remote-access form at least 3 weeks before travel. We'll coordinate sponsor letters if needed.
Marcus (Eng): What's the cancellation policy for vendor-booked venues?
Maya (People Ops): We try to book refundable options. For non-refundable deposits, teams should use team budget; People Ops maintains a small contingency for exec-level events. If cancellation is >21 days prior, full refund likely; <14 days, partial or prorated costs may apply.
Lina (Product): Are there new parental/medical accommodations for offsites?
Maya (People Ops): Yes 1 Please request as early as possible. We offer additional childcare stipend and flexible scheduling; People Ops will anonymize requests if desired.
Julian (CEO): One ask from leadership: when scheduling hub weeks, include 2-3 core overlap days for cross-team work. Not mandatory, but it helps coordination.
Marcus (Eng): How will we handle APAC rotation for folks visiting US hubs re: visas and tax implications?
Eve (Finance): Any stay >30 days triggers potential local tax/immigration review. Submit planned dates in the travel form and Finance will advise on tax exposure.
Priya (People Ops): Action items: we'll publish an "Offsite & Travel FAQ" with templates (visa letter request, travel form, expense categories), a one-page risk/backup template, and a desk-row reservation flow. ETA: Thursday COB.
Ben (Infrastructure): Can teams reserve contiguous desks for focused sprint weeks?
Maya (People Ops): Yes 1 request row reservations by sending dates + headcount to #people-ops. We'll prioritize recurring team weeks and critical sprints.
Lina (Product): Will there be a stipend for coworking in regions without hubs?
Priya (People Ops): Piloting a coworking stipend in APAC and LATAM. Initial cap: $150/month; details on rollout in the FAQ.
Marcus (Eng): Any preferred vendors for travel booking?
Eve (Finance): Use the approved vendor list in Confluence; if you need exceptions, tag Finance in the travel request.
Maya (People Ops): Note: for Dedicated/Private customer visits, coordinate with Security for SOPs and with People Ops for itineraries.
Julian (CEO): Thanks all. Appreciate teams aligning ahead of Q3 offsite windows.
